marketing.heroSubtitle: A climbing wall you unlock from your phone. Register, top up your entries, and open the gate yourself whenever your schedule allows.
marketing.aboutText: A summer climbing wall in Tišnov for members and drop-in visitors alike. Access is controlled by an electronic lock that you open yourself once your account is approved — no waiting for staff.
marketing.pricingText: You only pay for the entries you actually use — one-off credit packs or time-based passes depending on your membership type. You'll see current prices once you register and your account is approved.
marketing.contactText: Questions about membership or how the wall runs? Reach out to the admin at the address included in your registration email.
